data.title: 一色彩羽 · 商业街试戴发饰的镜前戏谑·「这个发箍好看吗？……前辈要是夸我可爱，我就买下来哦」
data.description: 【精品首饰店镜台前·周末】周末逛街约会。彩羽穿着松垮粉红毛衣露出一侧香肩，头上戴着刚挑的猫耳毛绒发箍。她双手托腮靠在饰品店镜子前朝你眨眼放电，小恶魔魅力拉满，引得周围路人频频侧目。
data.action: 试戴猫耳发箍双手托腮朝镜中眨眼放电，露肩毛衣娇艳可爱
data.lighting: 首饰店明亮暖白的环形灯与镜面反射
data.camera: medium shot, mirror reflection, wearing hairband, cat ears, wink
data.promptProse: Iroha Isshiki tries a plush cat-ear headband above wavy honey-brown hair, leaning on the accessory-shop counter with both cheeks in her palms and winking at her reflection. Pastel-pink mohair sweater, brown plaid skirt and small shoulder bag retain the chosen casual outfit. The medium view keeps the mirror and display trays around her. Warm-white ring lights illuminate her playful face and headband texture, with subdued shadows beneath the counter accessories.
